## What problem does this solve?

Describe the workflow or pain point this would address — not just the
feature itself. This makes it much easier to judge fit and, if the exact
shape you're picturing isn't quite right, to find an alternative that still
solves your actual problem.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see — a new page, an addition to an existing one, a new
built-in PSScript, a CLI/automation hook, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems better (if
applicable).

## Additional context

Anything else — e.g. how this compares to the equivalent feature in the
original [Client Center for Configuration Manager](https://github.com/rzander/sccmclictr),
if you know it from there.
